name: Meeting
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - NOVEMBER 5, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated November 5, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated November 5, 2012 in the total amount of $7,336,437.31.
B.
Successor Agency dated November 5, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated November 5, 2012 in the total amount of $71,000.00.
8.
Approval of a Treasurer's Report for the period ending September 30, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's Report for the period ending September 30, 2012.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of October 25, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of October 25, 2012.
End of Consent Calendar
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and consent by the City Council of the City of Cerritos to the execution of a sublease by Townsend Automotive Group, LLC, a California Limited Liability Company, to LRJ Automotive, LLC, a California Limited Liability Company, and approval of an Estoppel Certificate from the City of Cerritos and a sublease recognition, non-disturbance and attornment agreement among the parties, with respect to the operation of the Cerritos Jaguar-Land Rover Dealership franchise, located at 10861 183rd Street, Cerritos, California (APN 7034-017-909). (COUNCIL)
1. Review and discuss the information provided in this staff report; and
2. Authorize the City Manager to execute documents, including the Estoppel Certificate and Sublease Recognition, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement, substantially in the form included herein with such changes as the City Manager may deem appropriate, to facilitate, acknowledge and consent to the sublease of the property located at 10861 183rd Street, Cerritos, California, between Townsend Automotive Group and LRJ Automotive.
B.
Review and consideration of user group fees and use policies for Cerritos athletic fields and the Cerritos Olympic Swim and Fitness Center. (COUNCIL)
review the information provided in the staff report and approve the proposed fee increases, which will be effective April 2013.
11.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
13.
Adjournment
